snippet.title: Game Gear Longplay [021] T2 - The Arcade Game
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by MadMatty

The Last of the T2 Arcade Ports.  I almost shrugged this off as the usual Master System port, but there are notable differences.  This just sticks the middle finger up to the gameboy version and shows how the handheld version should have been done ;)

Initially it looks like the master system version with just the sides cut off, but its more then that.  The whole game area just seems to fit better, and looks more inline with other versions.  The master system version looks like its zoomed out so theres lots of empty space on the screen and takes a while to get the curser from one side to the other.

I think this version is a bit easier as I was able to find a couple of extra credits.  On the other hand, I did need the extra credits in this version.

This time, I got the best ending.  you cant miss a single piece of equipment in cyberdyne.  I thought I fugged it again missing 2 at the end, but thankfully the cpu and arm completed it.  You really have no room for error and cant miss a single thing! -
